standard_prerequisites.name: The notion of a property of morphisms of algebraic spaces being smooth local on the source and on the target, in the three forms recorded in the chapter on descent on spaces
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked repeatedly inside the counted proof (source lines 3319-3333 and 3364-3368) as cross-chapter pointers
standard_prerequisites.use: Allows the property to be moved along smooth morphisms and base changes in the comparison diagram.

standard_prerequisites.name: The description of a morphism from an algebraic space to an algebraic stack through a smooth presentation, and the stability of surjectivity and smoothness under composition and base change
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Used at the start of the counted proof (source lines 3269-3277) and later (proof lines 3307-3318)
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the diagram of the second condition from an arbitrary smooth presentation.

core_obligations: First implication: from a surjective smooth presentation of the target the proof builds a further surjective smooth presentation of the fibre product so that the resulting diagram is one of those considered in the first condition, whence the property passes to the chosen presentation (proof lines 3269-3277)

Comparison diagram: to deduce the first condition from the second the proof takes an arbitrary diagram as in the first condition and builds the large commutative diagram of algebraic spaces comparing the two presentations (proof lines 3280-3306)

Smoothness bookkeeping: the horizontal arrows of that diagram are smooth as base changes of the given smooth morphisms, and one vertical arrow is smooth because the second presentation satisfies the additional smoothness condition of the first condition (proof lines 3307-3318)

Transport along the localness: using the three parts of the smooth localness of the property the proof moves the property from the chosen presentation to the base change, then precomposes, then concludes the property for the arbitrary presentation (proof lines 3319-3337)

The representable cases: for representable morphisms the characterisation statement of the chapter on descent on spaces applies, and for a representable morphism with a property preserved under base change and fppf local on the base the proof checks the condition for an arbitrary base change by a scheme (proof lines 3340-3368)
proof_roadmap: (1)⇒(2)：取满光滑 V → Y 与 U → X ×_Y V 满光滑，则 U → X 也满光滑，于是得到一个 (1) 型图；由 (1) 得 h 有 P。

(2)⇒(1)：设 (2) 的图与任一 (1) 型图 U' → V'，作比较大图 U ← U ×_X U' → U'、V ← V ×_Y V' → V'。由 P 的 smooth local 三条：先把 P 从 h 搬到基变换 U ×_Y V' → V ×_Y V'，再沿光滑的 U ×_X U' → U ×_Y V' 前拉得 (h,h') 有 P，再由与 V ×_Y V' → V' 的复合得 U ×_X U' → V' 有 P，最后由满光滑的 U ×_X U' → U' 得 h' 有 P。
可表示情形与 fppf 局部情形分别用 descent on spaces 的刻画引理与 Z ×_Y 的基变换图验证。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement gives the standard smooth-local-on-the-source-and-target criterion for a property of morphisms of algebraic spaces to be defined for a morphism of algebraic stacks, together with its variants for representable morphisms (author lemma at source lines 3236-3266, label lemma-local-source-target). The proof (source lines 3268-3369) derives the second condition from the first by composing smooth presentations, then proves the converse by building a large comparison diagram of algebraic spaces whose arrows are smooth as base changes or composites of the given ones, and transfers the property along the three parts of the smooth localness (proof lines 3319-3337); the representable cases are reduced to the corresponding characterisation for algebraic spaces and to a base change diagram with a scheme (proof lines 3340-3368). The comparison diagram with its four transport steps is the content. H3.
